thread:
Isha Kumar: Quick flag 1 — customer reported quotas attributed to our proxy instead of their project when requests flow via partner proxies. Console shows the proxy sa as the caller. We need a way to preserve origin attribution across token exchanges.
Sam Baxter: Ack. Are we certain it's happening during the exchange and not in the edge where headers are dropped?
Marco Li: Traced a sample: partner-proxy does a token-exchange (client creds -> internal token), then forwards request with the new token but doesn't propagate original project id. So the gateway sees the proxy's service account claim.
Julia Chen: Telemetry confirms a jump in unattributed_count for that org at 03:12 UTC when they flipped the proxy. Also no trace samples for exchange path.
Isha Kumar: Proposal: let proxies attach a short-lived signed provenance header, e.g. X-ORIGIN-PROJ and X-ORIGIN-HMAC. Gateway verifies HMAC with a per-proxy shared key from KMS/truststore and if valid uses that value for billing/metrics attribution. If invalid or missing, fallback to token claim extraction.
Sam Baxter: Sounds reasonable. A few considerations: rotation of keys, what trust relationships we allow (partner proxies only), and console controls for enabling per-route acceptance.
Marco Li: Implementation plan in auth-proxy: generate HMAC using proxy private key: hmac = HMAC_SHA256(key, origin_project || timestamp). Add header X-ORIGIN-PROJ, X-ORIGIN-TS, X-ORIGIN-HMAC. Gateway will check timestamp window + verify HMAC. Pseudocode:```go
orig := req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-PROJ")
ts := req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-TS")
h := req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-HMAC")
if withinWindow(ts) && verifyHMAC(orig+ts, h, proxyKey) {
  attribution = orig
  method = "proxied-hmac"
} else {
  attribution = claims.ProjectID
  method = "token-claim"
}
emitMetric("request.attribution.count", map[string]string{"project": attribution, "method": method})
```
Julia Chen: For dashboards: add new breakdown card: attribution_method (token-claim | proxied-hmac | proxied-noheader | unknown). Also add a drilldown to show top partner proxies by proxied-noheader to catch misconfigs. Alert if proxied-noheader exceeds 3% of proxied traffic during canary.
Isha Kumar: Console UX: add a per-route toggle "Accept proxied origin headers (canary)" with rollout controls (10/25/50/100). Show an inline note: "Only partners on allowlist + signed header will be accepted." Link to audit logs for accepted header events.
Sam Baxter: Logging: reuse existing origin_project tag to avoid schema churn; add attribute origin_verified=true/false and attribution_method label. Also emit an audit event when we accept a proxied header that contains project != token claim.
Marco Li: Key rotation: proxy keys stored in KMS and rotated monthly. Gateway will support a truststore and key id header X-ORIGIN-KID so we can rotate without downtime. Verification will lookup by kid.
Julia Chen: Telemetry ingestion: add label attribution_method and origin_verified to downstream logs/metrics. We'll also sample traces for proxied-hmac failures for investigation.
Isha Kumar: Security caveats: gateway must check the proxy->project allowlist; even a valid signature is useless if proxy isn't authorized to assert that project. Also rate-limit header acceptance to avoid amplification attacks.
Sam Baxter: PM/Docs: need short customer-facing blurb explaining change and what partners must do. UX screenshots for the console toggle and rollout modal.
